title: introduce syncable-prefetch retry presets and python stream facade for multi-SDK parity
author: Aisha Kapoor
description: Motivation: customers see uneven tail latency when client-side prefetch and retry heuristics diverge across language SDKs. This PR implements a syncable prefetch strategy and a set of compact retry presets (latency-aware, throughput-lean, conservative) and introduces a lightweight Python stream facade to match ergonomics shipped in the TS/Go SDKs. It unifies telemetry labels for credential prefetch events so server-side correlators can reason about client-driven prefetch, and surfaces a small opt-in API (Stream.prefetch_policy) for teams that want deterministic warmup behavior. Changes include API surface parity, new retry presets wired into the session factory, unit + integration tests for prefetch behavior, and docs/examples. Checklist: - [x] design doc linked (Linear ENG-1428) - [x] proto/contract reviewed with SDK leads - [x] unit tests (prefetch, retry logic, stream iteration) - [x] e2e simulated burst tests in CI - [x] docs + example notebook - [x] version bump to 1.14.0 Release notes: Adds opt-in Stream.prefetch_policy and three retry presets for client-side ergonomics; aligns Python SDK stream semantics with TS/Go for credential prefetch and retry metrics. See linked Linear tickets for rollout plan. No behavioral change unless opted in. Rollout: feature gated behind SDK config defaulting to previous behavior; will flip after monitoring window. Related: SUP ticket SUP-7721 covers a customer incident that motivated exposing prefetch telemetry. Notes: kept implementation compact to avoid increasing import surface; uses existing session cache and background refresh worker with a configurable jitter schedule.

review_comments: Diego Martinez: Important perf question — the background refresh worker uses a single thread per process; will that saturate in high-concurrency server apps? Suggest making the worker pool size configurable. Reply (Aisha): Agreed; exposed SDK config 'prefetch.worker_pool' with default 1 and doc note explaining tradeoffs.

Renee Cho: Can we avoid importing heavy deps in streaming.__init__ to keep cold-start smaller? Suggest lazy import of the retry registry. Reply (Aisha): Moved registry init to lazy loader inside session_factory to avoid import-time cost.

Liam O'Connor: Tests flaked in CI on first run (integration prefetch burst); appears to be timing sensitive. Action: add deterministic jitter seed and a 50ms slack in the assertion. Reply (Aisha): Added deterministic seeding in tests and a short slack; re-ran CI and passes.
QA (Monica Patel): Please ensure telemetry fields include request_id and session_id — added schema example in docs. Reply (Aisha): telemetry schema updated and validated against test harness.

Security (Jin Park): quick review for auth surface — confirm no new secret material is persisted. Reply (Aisha): confirmed; only TTL and last-refresh timestamp persisted to in-memory cache, not on-disk.
merge_outcome: merged via squash merge on 2026-02-25 after two approvals (Diego Martinez, Renee Cho). Release tagged v1.14.0
release_notes: Added opt-in Stream.prefetch_policy (client-side warmup control) and three retry presets (latency-aware, throughput-lean, conservative). Python stream iteration now matches TS/Go semantics for credential prefetch events and telemetry. Version bumped to 1.14.0.
notes_for_backport: No API breaking changes; if backporting to 1.13.x, only cherry-pick tests and telemetry labels; avoid bumping default prefetch worker pool in patch releases.
